description: Replacement of existing single glazed windows comprising of metal, timber and uPVC framed windows with new double glazed timber framed windows; replacement of existing single glazed timber framed balcony doors with new double glazed timber framed doors at first floor level to the front elevation; replacement of existing flat roof covering with new roof coverings.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

0437 72 101
0437 72 102
Photographic Schedule
Heritage Style Sliding Sash Windows by Heron Joinery
Stormproof Casement Windows by Heron Joinery

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials specified on the drawings hereby approved. The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - Prior to the occupation of the development hereby permitted, the sash window at third floor level ref W-24)  in the south elevation on plan ref 0437 72 101shall be fitted with obscure glass to a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3, and shall be non-opening and fixed shut up to a height of 1.7m above the finished floor level. The casement windows on the first and second floor  ref (W-20 and (W22) plan ref 0437 72 101shall  shall be permanently obscure glazed and fitted with a restricted opening mechanism so that the window cannot open more than 100mm. The windows shall thereafter be permanently retained as approved.

To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in terms of privacy and overlooking in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).
